starts without this one's messages.

Each demo request returns one more input-output pair of the task, up to the demo cap shown
with the input.

each demo request. An instance is over when a submission is correct or when the attempt

many submissions and demo requests it used. Feedback on a submission is only

the instance is over. Each instance is scored on its own, and lower cost is better.

base='/home/ubuntu/runs/paper/glm-hpl-u1-turns/play/users/u000/system/state/workspace/programs'

from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    bg=Counter(x for r in grid for x in r).most_common(1)[0][0]
    out=[r[:] for r in grid]
    seen=[[False]*w for _ in range(h)]
    for i in range(h):
        for j in range(w):
            if grid[i][j]!=bg and not seen[i][j]:
                c=grid[i][j]; stack=[(i,j)]; comp=[]; seen[i][j]=True
                while stack:
                    y,x=stack.pop(); comp.append((y,x))
                    for dy,dx in((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                        ny,nx=y+dy,x+dx
                        if 0<=ny<h and 0<=nx<w and not seen[ny][nx] and grid[ny][nx]==c:
                            seen[ny][nx]=True; stack.append((ny,nx))
                ys=[p[0] for p in comp]; xs=[p[1] for p in comp]
                y0,y1,x0,x1=min(ys),max(ys),min(xs),max(xs)
                if y1-y0>=2 and x1-x0>=2 and len(comp)==2*(y1-y0+1)+2*(x1-x0-1):
                    area=(y1-y0-1)*(x1-x0-1)
                    fill=2 if area%2==0 else 7
                    for yy in range(y0+1,y1):
                        for xx in range(x0+1,x1):
                            if grid[yy][xx]==bg: out[yy][xx]=fill
    return out
''')
